records.title: InvIT ISSUE BROUGHT BY NHAI
details: a: The Government has decided to set up a Public InvIT in addition to National Highways Infra Trust (NHIT).However, the size of the bundle of the National Highways or the extent of offerings for retail investors is to be decided.

records.title: Support to Bat Manufacturers
details:
a to b): However, this Ministry implements a Scheme namely “Micro and Small
Enterprises- Cluster Development Program” under which, a Common Facility Centre at Cricket Bat Manufacturing Industry Cluster Anantnag, Jammu and Kashmir has been approved.
